A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MotionReFit work. Their complete 28-page contents, including equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–F, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original motion-editing experiments, quantitative comparisons, ablations, and qualitative results on STANCE and MotionFix in Section 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the main comparisons and supplementary evaluations and demonstrations.

M1.justification: MotionCutMix blending rules, MotionReFit's autoregressive diffusion architecture, conditioning, and body part coordinator remain unchanged in Sections 4–5 and Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same STANCE tasks, HumanML3D motion base, and MotionFix benchmark. The supplementary temporal, interactive, and compositional editing scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across corresponding experiments: MDM-BP and TMED remain the baselines, with TMED using MotionCutMix retained in Tables 1 and A1.

E3.justification: The data splits, retrieval-gallery settings, metrics, preprocessing, model configurations, and training budgets remain identical in Section 6.1 and Appendices B–C.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same component ablations, augmentation-ratio and annotation-size analyses, window-size and convergence experiments, guidance sweep, and qualitative case studies.

E5.justification: Table 1 reports means over 10 evaluations with 95% confidence intervals in both versions. Repeated-evaluation counts, mean-reporting conventions, and the matched-seed comparison in Figure 7 are unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical entries in Tables 1–2 and A1–A4, plotted results, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains full-model FID values of 0.20 for body part replacement and 0.14 for style transfer.

T1.justification: The motion representations, spatial blending definition, diffusion and guidance equations (1–4), and supplementary mathematical descriptions remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about versatile editing, MotionCutMix generalization, MotionReFit performance, and the STANCE dataset.

C2.justification: The explanations of augmentation and coordination, task-dependent interpretation of E2S, and limitations concerning temporal dependencies, spatial understanding, and unfamiliar instructions remain unchanged, including Appendices C and F.

D1.justification: Architecture details, preprocessing instructions, guidance parameters, training hardware and duration, inference timings, dataset construction details, and the project link are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the 72-item reference list are unchanged. The positioning relative to TMED, motion composition, and prior motion-editing approaches is retained.

P1.justification: v2 replaces 'Appendix/Appendices' with 'Sec./Secs.' in cross-references, changes the acknowledged grant number from 62376031 to 62376009, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and A1–A14 and Tables 1–2 and A1–A4 retain the same displays, captions, and placement. The cross-reference edits produce only local prose rewrapping; the 11 pages of qualitative appendix figures are pixel-identical.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the scientific content, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations of v1. The cross-reference wording and administrative updates do not establish a meaningful net change in the paper's clarity, validity, or evidential support.
